# Tests that .github/workflows/build-and-test.yml runs against the debug build.
#
# One filter per line, passed to scripts/runner.node.ts as a positional. A filter
# selects every test file under test/ whose path (relative to test/) contains it,
# so a directory selects everything below it and a filter that matches nothing
# selects nothing. Blank lines and lines starting with # are ignored.

# Smoke set
js/bun/util/escapeHTML.test.js
js/bun/util/bun-isMainThread.test.js
js/bun/spawn/exit-code.test.ts
js/web/workers/worker.test.ts

# Concurrency (goroutines + channels)
js/bun/concurrency/
